CIBIL Score for Loans:

Your CIBIL score (300–900) determines your loan eligibility and interest rate.

✅ 750+: Best rates, easy approval
✅ 650–749: Good, may need additional documents
✅ Below 650: Difficult, higher rates

How to improve:
• Pay EMIs on time (35% weight)
• Keep credit utilization below 30%
• Don't close old credit cards
• Check your report for errors

We work with lenders who accept various score ranges. Even with 600+, we can help.
